sessionStart.prompt:
The user is working on the 'nvm-manager' project: a local web tool with an Angular frontend (apps/web/, port 4200) and an Express backend (apps/api/, port 3789) for managing nvm Node.js versions.

## Architecture Context

nvm is a shell function, not a binary. The backend spawns a 'bash -c' subshell for every nvm call (apps/api/src/nvm/nvm.service.ts). Binding to 127.0.0.1 ONLY. No database – nvm itself is the single source of truth. Angular Signals instead of NgRx for state management. 'nvm use' is implemented internally as 'nvm alias default' (persistent switch). Shell injection protection is two-layered: whitelist regex (nvm.types.ts) + single-quote escaping (nvm.service.ts).

## Component Overview

Angular: App (root with Signals) → Organisms (StatusCard, ActionCard, InstalledVersionsCard, AliasesCard, RemoteVersionsCard, LogCard) → Molecules (Card) → Atoms (Spinner, LoadingState) + InstallModalComponent.
Express: server.ts → routes/nvm.routes.ts → nvm/nvm.service.ts + nvm/nvm.parser.ts + nvm/nvm.types.ts.

## Available Skills
- 'project-explainer': Detailed explanation of architecture, components, design decisions
- 'angular-expert': Angular 17+ Standalone, Signals, HttpClient
- 'nodejs-express-expert': Express, Child Process, SSE, error handling
- 'formatting-linting-expert': Prettier, ESLint Flat Config, angular-eslint
- 'testing-expert': Vitest, Supertest, @testing-library/angular, Playwright
- 'documentation-expert': TSDoc, OpenAPI/Swagger, user handbook
- 'a11y-expert': WCAG 2.1 AA, ARIA roles, focus management, live regions, accessible tables/modals/buttons

Security is critical: backend only on 127.0.0.1, exclusively whitelist-approved nvm commands, strict input validation.
